title: arthropteris webbiana

It is traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Arthropteris webbiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
